name: Breakout Confirmation
description: Volatility-contraction breakout review after a base, resistance close, and volume expansion.

entryRules.label: A multi-week base exists before breakout.
Recent range has contracted before breakout.
Volume is at least 1.5x the 20-day average.

exitRules.label: Exit review if data quality becomes unusable or not ready.
Exit review if the market gate closes or regime turns risk-off.
Exit review after a close below strategy support.
Exit review when sector/relative strength decays.
Exit review when price-volume distribution appears.
Exit review when signal score or confidence decays.

invalidationRules.label: Invalidate entry evidence when data quality is missing, unusable, or not ready.
Invalidate the setup when price loses rule support.
Invalidate new long-entry review when market gate closes.
Invalidate breakout if price loses breakout support.

noiseFilters.label: Reject if price is more than 18% above SMA50.

riskRules.label: Volume confirmation is required for stronger breakout rating.
Default stop loss limits failed breakouts.
Default trailing stop protects gains after breakout.

marketGateRules.label: Market should be open or selective.

explanationTemplate: Triggered when breakout price action is confirmed by volume.

triggers: New high with high volume and bullish signal.
blocks: Breakout is too extended above SMA50.
